title: Web Vitals and Performance
description: Understand Core Web Vitals and frontend performance metrics.

options.text: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) measures the time for the entire page to finish rendering
options.explanation: LCP measures when the largest content element (image, text block) becomes visible. It's about perceived load speed, not complete render. Good LCP is under 2.5 seconds.

options.text: CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) measures unexpected layout movements during the page lifecycle
options.explanation: CLS quantifies how much visible content unexpectedly shifts. Common causes: images without dimensions, dynamically injected content, web fonts causing FOIT/FOUT. Good CLS is under 0.1.

options.text: FID (First Input Delay) measures how fast the browser renders the first pixel
options.explanation: FID measures the delay between a user's first interaction (click, tap) and the browser's response. First pixel render is measured by FCP (First Contentful Paint). FID has been replaced by INP (Interaction to Next Paint).

options.text: Lazy loading images always improves LCP
options.explanation: Lazy loading above-the-fold images can HURT LCP by delaying the largest content element. Only lazy-load below-the-fold images. Use `loading='eager'` (default) for hero images.
